solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Small body of soldiers also included in scheme

indicators.note: one word is placed inside another, the word for also going into the word for scheme

parts.note: a scheme is a plan
also means too

explanation.surface: A small group of troops is folded into some larger military scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'included in' signals one word going inside another.
explanation.definitionFit: A platoon is a military unit of a few dozen soldiers, a subdivision of a company.

clue.text: Left invoice around country area in Dorset

indicators.note: the words for left and invoice go around the word for country, sitting either side of it

parts.note: port is the nautical left-hand side of a ship
an invoice is a bill
a country is a land

explanation.surface: Someone abandons an unpaid bill somewhere in the English county of Dorset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks like a verb, but is the sailor's word for the left side. Dorset is a county on England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: Portland Bill is a narrow headland at the southern tip of the Isle of Portland, a well-known spot on the Dorset coast.

clue.text: Lively girl on radio took a partner

indicators.note: something heard on the radio is only heard, so the girl's name is written as it sounds

parts.note: Annie is a girl's name
to have mated is to have paired up with a partner

explanation.surface: A cheerful girl heard on a radio show has found herself a partner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on radio' lets the name Annie stand for the letters ANI, which sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Animated describes someone full of life and energy, a close synonym of lively.

clue.text: Old archdeacon's kitchen appliance

parts.note: Ven, short for Venerable, is the title given to an archdeacon in the Church of England

explanation.surface: An elderly clergyman's ancient cooker.
explanation.walkthrough: An archdeacon is styled 'the Venerable', abbreviated Ven.
explanation.definitionFit: An oven is the enclosed heated cooking chamber found in most kitchens.

clue.text: One taken in by unacceptable idea

indicators.note: the numeral for one is absorbed inside the phrase for unacceptable

parts.note: something 'not on' is unacceptable in British idiom
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone is fooled by a ridiculous idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' looks like being deceived, but signals insertion. The unacceptable phrase is British idiom.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion is a thought or belief, the same sense as an idea.

clue.text: Adorn husband, as well as ship's crew member

parts.note: to deck is to decorate or adorn
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy
as well as means and

explanation.surface: A wife dresses up her husband alongside a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A deckhand is a junior sailor who works on the deck of a vessel.

clue.text: Unemployed superstar, by the sound of it

indicators.note: the word for a superstar is heard rather than seen, giving a word pronounced the same

parts.note: an idol is an adored star

explanation.surface: A former celebrity is now out of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle can mean without a job or occupation, so not working.

clue.text: Old Italian composer finally prepared and cooked too much?

parts.note: Giuseppe Verdi was the Italian opera composer

indicators.note: finally signals taking the last letter of prepared

explanation.surface: An elderly Italian composer finally got dinner ready and overcooked it.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as an example: overcooking is one way of going too far.
explanation.definitionFit: Overdid means went to excess, and food overdone has been left too long on the heat.

clue.text: Food shop in abandoned citadel to north of Ruhr city

indicators.note: in a down answer, the first piece sits above, or north of, the second
abandoned suggests wild or unrestrained, so the letters of citadel are rearranged

parts.note: Essen is a city in Germany's Ruhr region

explanation.surface: A grocer's shop sits in a deserted fortress north of a German industrial city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' looks like describing a deserted citadel, but it signals the anagram DELICAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicatessen is a shop selling prepared foods such as cooked meats and cheeses.

clue.text: First-class male in torn clothing

indicators.note: the pieces for first-class and male are placed inside the word for torn

parts.note: rent is an old past tense of rend, meaning torn
A1 means first-class, written AI with the letter I for the figure one

explanation.surface: A top-notch man is wearing ripped clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: A1, the mark of top quality, is written AI in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an old literary word for garments or dress.

clue.text: Popular king satisfactorily providing writer's aid

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
K is the chess abbreviation for king
well means satisfactorily

explanation.surface: A well-liked monarch is doing nicely at helping an author.
explanation.definitionFit: An inkwell held ink for dipping pens, a traditional writing aid.

clue.text: Metal device for controlling dog

definitions.meaning: a heavy grey metallic element, chemical symbol Pb
a leash attached to a dog's collar

explanation.surface: A metal chain used to keep a dog in check.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the soft heavy element and a dog's leash.

clue.text: Sick cat faints? That's bizarre

indicators.note: sick suggests something unwell or disordered, so the letters of cat faints are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ill cat passes out, which would be a strange sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sick' looks like describing the cat, but it signals rearranging all nine letters of CAT FAINTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Fantastic can mean strange or fanciful, wildly beyond the ordinary, as bizarre does.

clue.text: Miserable-looking person following one twice around hospital

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

indicators.note: the doubled word goes around the abbreviation for hospital
the word for one is written two times in a row

parts.note: an ace is a one in a pack of cards
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A gloomy person trails a patient who keeps circling the hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twice' gives ACEACE, and 'around' puts H inside near its end.
explanation.definitionFit: Face-ache is informal British slang for someone who looks sullen or glum.

clue.text: Publican introducing French writer to sailor

indicators.note: the writer is brought into the middle of the word for sailor

parts.note: a tar is an old word for a sailor
Jules Verne was the French novelist

explanation.surface: A pub landlord introduces a French author to a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introducing ... to' looks like making acquaintances, but signals putting the writer inside the sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A taverner is an old word for one who runs a tavern, a pub keeper.

clue.text: Showing commitment, as some books may be

definitions.meaning: inscribed by the author to a named person at the front

explanation.surface: Displaying devotion, as certain volumes do.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means devoted, and a book addressed by its author to someone carries an inscription of tribute.

clue.text: First of three successors belonging to them

indicators.note: First of signals taking the opening letter of three

parts.note: heirs are those who succeed to an estate or title

explanation.surface: The eldest of three inheritors holds what is theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive pronoun means owned by those people.

clue.text: Reportedly receive sound in this place

indicators.note: reportedly means as said aloud, so the word for receiving sound is replaced by one pronounced alike

parts.note: to hear is to receive sound through the ears

explanation.surface: Someone claims they can pick up a sound in this spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means at or in this location.

clue.text: Provoke trendy lover

parts.note: in means fashionable or trendy
a flame, as in an old flame, is a lover

explanation.surface: Stir up jealousy in a fashionable sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: To inflame is to stir up anger or passion, so to provoke.

clue.text: Become tired making banner

definitions.meaning: a piece of cloth bearing an emblem, flown from a pole

explanation.surface: Someone tires while making a banner.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to droop with fatigue and a cloth standard.

clue.text: Facts kept in certain folders

indicators.note: kept in signals letters stored inside the words certain folders

explanation.surface: Data is stored in particular files.
explanation.definitionFit: Info is the informal short form of information, meaning facts or data.

clue.text: Wife abandons prize money for spell at wicket

indicators.note: the wife leaves the word for prize money, so her letter is taken out

parts.note: winnings are the money won as a prize

explanation.surface: A wife walks away from the jackpot.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the wicket is where the batter stands.
explanation.definitionFit: An innings is a cricketer's turn at batting, a spell at the crease.

clue.text: Cricket ball found in meadow by the river

parts.note: a lea is a poetic word for a meadow

explanation.surface: A cricket ball has been lost in a riverside field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cricket ball' could be a thing to find, but is the definition; cricket balls are made of red leather.
explanation.definitionFit: Leather is cricket slang for the ball, from the material that covers it.

clue.text: After short game, managed to make pouch

indicators.note: after places the word for managed behind the shortened game
short means cut short, so the word for game loses its last letter

parts.note: a sport is a game
ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: Following a brief match, someone succeeds in sewing a bag.
explanation.walkthrough: A sporran is the purse worn at the front of a Scottish kilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporran is a small leather or fur pouch hung from the belt of a kilt.
